description: VERITAS: For Wireless Channel Change Detection in 5G Networks is a data set deposited in Harvard Dataverse by its authors Nasim Soltani. This dataset contains training and test sets for training and testing the Monitor component in the following paper: Soltani, Nasim, Michael Löhning, and Kaushik Chowdhury. "VERITAS: Verifying the Performance of AI-native Transceiver Actions in Base-Stations." IEEE Transactions on Mobile Computing (2025). Link to github repository: https://github.com/nasimsoltani/VERITAS/. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is not stated (no licence in the Dataverse metadata read on 2026-09-29). Caveats: written from the Dataverse search and dataset metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support communication-network and digital-infrastructure studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-hdv-repository.
